about.title: The WoodHub story
paragraphs: Shopping for wooden furniture takes far too much time: customers search everywhere to find a piece they like, then compare prices across dozens of different workshops and suppliers — yet still struggle to picture how the item will actually look in their own room.

On the other side, small workshops and businesses have almost no online channel of their own. They depend almost entirely on nearby walk-in customers, so even with great craftsmanship they find it hard to reach new buyers.

WoodHub was started by Nguyễn Tuấn Toàn (team leader) to solve exactly these two problems: a platform that helps customers find, compare and preview products right in their real space, while opening a digital channel for small workshops. What sets WoodHub apart is AI product advice, AR/3D preview, made-to-order custom design, and a direct link between businesses and production workshops.
about.illustrationQuote: From a workshop in Tan Binh
about.illustrationDesc: to a platform connecting hundreds of workshops with customers nationwide.
